env_paras.num_jobs: Number of jobs during training; test dimensions are read from each instance.
env_paras.num_mas: TOTAL number of machines across all factories.
env_paras.ope_feat_dim: Keep 6: legacy environment operation features. TRG constructs 8 inputs internally.
env_paras.ma_feat_dim: Keep 4: legacy environment machine features. TRG constructs 6 inputs internally.
env_paras.pair_feat_dim: Keep 4: raw environment pair features. TRG constructs separate 8D tgrl_pair features and 8D successor-edge features internally.
env_paras.show_mode: print by default; draw enables optional matplotlib visualization.
env_paras.valid_batch_size: Number of validation instances; enough files must exist.

model_paras.hidden_dim: Shared graph embedding width; divisible by attention_heads.
model_paras.attention_heads: Number of attention heads for eligibility, suffix and successor relations.
model_paras.graph_layers: Number of relational layers and action-factor layers.
model_paras.n_latent_critic: Value and action-critic MLP hidden width.
model_paras.use_timetable_graph: Enable timetable suffix DP, catchability edges, phase features and departure factors.
model_paras.store_rollout_on_cpu: Store compact graph snapshots on CPU; transfer minibatches for updates.

train_paras.gamma: Discount factor; keep 1.0 for the telescoping makespan objective.
train_paras.entropy_coeff: Entropy coefficient; entropy is divided by log(max(number of feasible actions,2)).
train_paras.max_iterations: Number of training episodes, each containing batch_size parallel instances.
train_paras.save_timestep: Validate every this many iterations; always validate the final iteration.
train_paras.update_timestep: Accumulate complete episodes for this many iterations before PPO update.
train_paras.viz: Enable optional Visdom, disabled by default.
train_paras.minibatch_size: Number of REAL state-action transitions per optimizer step.
train_paras.parallel_iter: Regenerate training instances every this many iterations.
train_paras.cf_coeff: Final GCO graph control-variate coefficient (PPO-based optimization). Set cf_coeff=q_coeff=0 for ordinary PPO ablation.
train_paras.cf_warmup_updates: Linear ramp length for the control-variate coefficient.
train_paras.target_kl: Exact old-to-new KL target; stop at 1.5 times this value. Zero disables stopping.
train_paras.seed: Python, NumPy and PyTorch random seed. Use independent seeds for experiments.
train_paras.check_feasibility: Check every training schedule. Validation/test schedules are always checked.

test_paras.num_ins: Maximum number of sorted .fjs test instances.
test_paras.rules: Use ["TGRL"] to scan *.pt in model_dir (legacy DRL/CALM selectors also work); otherwise list exact .pt filenames.
test_paras.sample: False: greedy. True: sample independent complete trajectories and choose the best.
test_paras.num_sample: Number of independent trajectories per instance when sampling.
test_paras.num_average: Repeat inference; report mean score and time across repetitions.
test_paras.public_ins: Legacy compatibility field; unused by the new test entry point.
test_paras.data_path: Subdirectory of data_test, e.g. 100502 or Public_02; J/M/F are read from each file.
test_paras.model_dir: Directory of TGRL .pt policy state dictionaries matching model_paras and the 8D pair input.
test_paras.seed: Python, NumPy and PyTorch random seed. Use independent seeds for experiments.
